name: Azeroth Mixtape
author: NeedleDropper
description: The default NeedleDropper soundtrack for World of Warcraft: Forever, with needle drops at the places every player remembers: all six capitals, every starting zone, the signature zones, the famous landmarks and the four new Forever zones. Roughly half the songs fit so well they give you chills and half are there to make you laugh (metadata only; no audio is included).

drops.title: 9 to 5
drops.note: Your first job in the Valley of Trials is waking lazy peons, so Durotar opens with an anthem for the working orc.

drops.title: The John Dunbar Theme
drops.note: Endless golden plains, wind in the tall grass and mesas on the horizon: a frontier theme fit for the tauren homeland.

drops.title: Africa
drops.note: Lions, zhevra and endless golden savanna: Barrens chat finally gets the meme anthem it has always deserved.

drops.title: I Still Haven't Found What I'm Looking For
drops.note: Every Horde hero at the Crossroads ends up asking Barrens chat where Mankrik's wife is. Bono hasn't found her either.

drops.title: May It Be
drops.note: Moonlight on the World Tree and the most elven song in film history, for the night elves' first steps into the world.

drops.title: Rocket Man (I Think It's Going to Be a Long, Long Time)
drops.note: Gnome and goblin rocket cars tear across the salt flats, and you're the one stuck collecting Rocket Car Parts.

drops.title: Sandstorm
drops.note: An entire desert of blowing sand, and the one song that is basically required by law to play there.

drops.title: Money, Money, Money
drops.note: Steamwheedle goblins sell to Horde and Alliance alike, as long as the gold is real and the auction cut is theirs.

drops.title: Toxic
drops.note: Fel-poisoned rivers, oozing slimes and a forest rotten to the roots: Felwood is literally toxic. Britney said it first.

drops.title: Theme from Jurassic Park
drops.note: A lost crater of dinosaurs, steaming springs and glowing crystals. There's only one way a film would score this arrival.

drops.title: Dust in the Wind
drops.note: Wind-scoured dunes over a buried Qiraji empire, where whole armies of the Ahn'Qiraj war effort turned to sand.

drops.title: Ice Ice Baby
drops.note: The coldest town in vanilla WoW gets the most vanilla Ice of all.

drops.title: Now We Are Free
drops.note: Thrall fought as a gladiator slave, then freed the orcs from the camps. His city gets Gladiator's anthem of freedom.

drops.title: Free Fallin'
drops.note: For everyone who ever stepped off a Thunder Bluff elevator one second too early.

drops.title: All by Myself
drops.note: Azeroth's loveliest capital and famously its emptiest: the bank, the auction house and the moonwell are all yours.

drops.title: Who Wants to Live Forever
drops.note: Night elves gave up their immortality on this mountain to stop Archimonde, and now the whole game is called Forever.

drops.title: Viva la Vida
drops.note: Highborne exiles still dressed for an empire that fell ten thousand years ago, scored with a deposed king's lament.

drops.title: Highway to Hell
drops.note: On the far side of the portal lies Hellfire Peninsula, and AC/DC named the road there back in 1979.

drops.title: Bring Me to Life
drops.note: The Forsaken begin by waking up dead in Deathknell, so Tirisfal gets the internet's most famous plea to be woken up.

drops.title: Hallelujah
drops.note: The last holy ground in the Plaguelands, where the Argent Dawn still kneel: arrive, breathe and let it play.

drops.title: War
drops.note: Southshore vs. Tarren Mill raged for months before battlegrounds and earned exactly what this song says war is good for.

drops.title: Brothers in Arms
drops.note: Tarren Mill vs. Southshore, vanilla's endless world-PvP war, scored by rock's most mournful soldiers' lament. Timed to the 4:58 single edit.

drops.title: Test Drive
drops.note: Wildhammer gryphons and Celtic fiddles: How to Train Your Dragon's first-flight cue was all but written for this cliff.

drops.title: Misty Mountains
drops.note: Deep dwarven voices mourning a lost mountain home: written for Erebor, felt by every gnome who fled Gnomeregan.

drops.title: We Didn't Start the Fire
drops.note: The Dark Irons summoned Ragnaros and set this whole land ablaze. Ask any of them, though, and it wasn't their fault.

drops.title: Here Comes the Sun
drops.note: Dawn over Northshire Abbey and a whole world ahead: the gentlest possible start to an adventure.

drops.title: Hotel California
drops.note: Azeroth's most notorious inn since 2004. The Lion's Pride never closes, and its regulars have been here since launch.

drops.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
drops.note: Medivh's tower: a possessed wizard, a haunted ballroom and its own opera house. Only rock's most operatic epic will do.

drops.title: Thriller
drops.note: Worgen in the woods, ghouls at Raven Hill and Stitches on the road: Duskwood is basically the music video.

drops.title: Welcome to the Jungle
drops.note: Raptors, tigers, trolls and a gank behind every tree: Stranglethorn is exactly the jungle Axl warned you about.

drops.title: He's a Pirate
drops.note: Walk through the jaws of a giant shark into a goblin pirate harbour, and only one cue can possibly be playing.

drops.title: Skyfall
drops.note: Skyfall, but make it Westfall: a Bond-sized ballad for broken windmills and a Defias Brotherhood plotting its return.

drops.title: (Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay
drops.note: Rain, gulls and the long wait for the boat: every Alliance player has spent a small lifetime on these docks.

drops.title: "Heroes"
drops.note: You walk in beneath the giant champion statues of the Valley of Heroes, and Bowie's anthem names the place for you.

drops.title: Diggy Diggy Hole
drops.note: A whole city carved out of a mountain by dwarves who have never once stopped digging. This is their work song.

drops.title: Cities in Dust
drops.note: The Banshee Queen rules a city beneath the ashes of Lordaeron, so naturally the Banshees supply the anthem.

drops.title: River
drops.note: A brand-new land of rivers and reeds, welcomed with a hushed, gospel-quiet hymn about being baptised in the water.

drops.title: Mr. Blue Sky
drops.note: A Skyborne hero's very first needle drop: an island floating above the clouds gets the sunniest ode to the sky ever recorded.
